mentions.name: topsongs.io
mentions.description: A browser game where players try to guess the top 10 most streamed songs for a given musician, inspired by a pub guessing game the author played with friends. It offers a cleaner, more user-friendly alternative to reading stream aggregator lists online that are cluttered with ads.
mentions.problem: Stream aggregator lists online are hard to read and full of ads, making the pub game of guessing a musician's top streamed songs cumbersome to play.
mentions.source_excerpt:
My friends and I would often sit in pubs trying to guess the top 10 most streamed songs for a musician so I had a go at turning it into a browser game.

https://topsongs.io/
